newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabia beheads man for murder.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia beheads man for murder.

text.p: Saudi Arabia beheaded a Saudi man on Wednesday for stabbing a compatriot to death during a dispute, Saudi state television reported.
An interior ministry statement carried by the television said the victim died after being stabbed once with a knife.
The beheading in Riyadh raised to 59 the number of people executed in the conservative Moslem kingdom so far this year.
Four Pakistanis -- two women and two men -- and a Nigerian man were beheaded on Tuesday for drug smuggling.
Saudi Arabia strictly enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading by the sword convicted murderers, drug smugglers, rapists and other criminals.
